role: Replacement for Combine @Published sinks: a self-re-arming withObservationTracking loop that calls onChange on the main actor each time observed @Observable state changes, with a cancel handle.
types: ObservationHandle: class (@MainActor) — cancellation flag for one loop

flags.text: No test in EmuquTests references ObservationLoop or ObservationHandle, although it drives bindings in RRCollector, WorkoutTicker, AssistantViewModel, HistoryViewModel and WatchConnectivityBridge.

units.does: Sets isCancelled = true so the next fire()/deliverInitial() returns without delivering or re-arming; the currently armed withObservationTracking still fires once (into a no-op).
Creates an ObservationHandle, optionally schedules a one-hop-deferred initial delivery, arms the first withObservationTracking pass reading `read(owner)`, and returns the handle (discardable).

branches.effect: schedules deliverInitial (deferred Task on main actor) before arming; when false only arms, so the first callback happens on the first change (replaces .dropFirst())

units.does: Spawns a @MainActor Task holding owner weakly that calls onChange(owner, read(owner)) once, unless the owner was released or the handle cancelled.
calls: closure:onChange/read supplied by observe() callers (RRCollector+Bindings, WorkoutTicker, AssistantViewModel, etc.)

branches.cond: owner still alive and handle not cancelled
branches.effect: delivers current value; otherwise returns silently without delivering

units.does: Runs withObservationTracking, touching read(owner) to register dependencies; on the (one-shot, pre-mutation) change callback, spawns a @MainActor Task that calls fire() with the owner captured weakly.
One delivery: if owner alive and handle not cancelled, calls onChange(owner, read(owner)) with the post-mutation value and re-arms via arm(); otherwise ends the loop.

branches.effect: returns without delivering and without re-arming, ending the loop permanently; when false delivers and re-arms
